issues.issue: The four groups are factually sound in the exact ordinary displayed senses. DEX recognizes tree bark, terrestrial crust, cerebral cortex and a book cover as scoarță. Cacao is explicitly the KG food-powder identity, and flour, powdered sugar and food starch share that physical form. Piano keys, phone side buttons, remote buttons and the ordinary household light switch support finger-operated controls; Apple primary documentation confirms that touchscreen phones still have physical buttons. Watering can, garden hose, bucket and tap can be used to water plants; the wording does not claim all were exclusively manufactured for gardening. Printed-book and household-switch senses are required, not universal assertions about every e-book or switch variant. Sources: https://dexonline.ro/definitie/scoar%C8%9B%C4%83/definitii ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/f%C4%83in%C4%83 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/cacao ; https://dexonline.ro/intrare/pudr%C4%83/46419 ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/pian ; https://support.apple.com/ro-ro/guide/iphone/iphb71f9b54d/ios ; https://www.gardena.com/ro/produse/irigarea/fitinguri-furtun .
